title: Evaluation of a constant sparse Fourier hypothesis
statement: For any natural number $n$ and any sign $b\in\{-1,1\}$, the Boolean function obtained by evaluating the sparse Fourier hypothesis with its sole Fourier coefficient equal to $b$ is the constant function with value $b$.
